description: This file defines the HttpRequestTask class, a workflow activity for making HTTP requests within OrchardCore workflows. It includes properties for URL, method, headers, body, and response codes, and handles executing HTTP requests and processing responses.

classes.name: HttpRequestTask
classes.description: A workflow activity class for executing HTTP requests, parsing headers and response codes, and returning outcomes based on response status.

methods.name: GetPossibleOutcomes
methods.description: Generates possible outcomes based on configured HTTP response codes.

methods.name: ExecuteAsync
methods.description: Performs the HTTP request, processes the response, and sets the last result in the workflow context.

methods.name: ParseHeaders
methods.description: Parses raw header string into key-value pairs.

methods.name: ParseResponseCodes
methods.description: Parses response codes from a comma-separated string into integers.
